title: Introduce General Shell Branding With Entwerfen mit Bestand Aggregator
description: Introduce a first-class ShellBrand mechanism so framework shell apps can ship as differently-branded standalone builds: brand identity (window title, logo SVG, favicon), locked preference axes, defaulted axes (new SEMIO_DEFAULT_EXAMPLE channel), and a brand-owned introduction. Wire a registry `brand` column on playground rows and use it to add the "Entwerfen mit Bestand Aggregator" variant — a branded standalone puzzle3d with locked German locale, locked reuse terminology, locked semio theme, switchable appearance, typographic wordmark logo, custom German introduction, and Abbau Aufbau (concrete-forest) as default-but-switchable example — including dev/build configs, package.json scripts, and launch.json entries on port 6023.
summary:
Confirmed the Entwerfen mit Bestand Aggregator works end to end, per the dev's explicit "must work end to end" directive. Found and fixed three additional real bugs beyond the earlier session's work, plus three infrastructure root causes that were blocking verification entirely.

App bugs fixed:
1. Katalog panel-tab toggle hidden behind opaque glass on the introduction's catalogue step (the originally reported bug) — root cause was `emphasis: "none"` on the catalogue/add-object steps in the brand's introduction, when the Rust `IntroductionEmphasis` default (which the original unbranded puzzle3d intro relies on for the same steps) is `Cutout`; "none" produces a full opaque veil with no interactive gap. Fixed both to "cutout" in framework/product/os/dev/brand/entwerfen-mit-bestand.brand.ts. Confirmed fixed via 4 independent screenshot-verified walkthroughs.
2. A genuine hang/freeze bug in ui/js/react/index.tsx's useIntroductionAnchorRect: the MutationObserver rewrite called setResolution with a brand-new object literal on every DOM mutation anywhere on the page while an anchor never resolves — since object identity always differs, this forced a React re-render on every unrelated page-wide mutation (e.g. a live 3D viewport), causing a rendering storm that hung the browser tab at the step-4-to-5 transition (reproduced 3x). Fixed with a `reportedUnresolved` guard so the unresolved state is only reported once, not on every subsequent mutation. Confirmed fixed: the same transition that hung 3 times succeeded immediately after the fix.
3. Wrong i18n key path from the earlier session (introduction/tooltip/settings are siblings of `ui` at the UiTranslationSchema root, not nested under it) — fixed "ui.introduction.*" to "introduction.*", confirmed live.

Infrastructure root causes fixed (all in framework/product/os/dev/js/vite.config.ts and .claude/launch.json), each of which was fully killing the dev server before any app-level testing was even possible:
1. The root script.ts dev dispatcher's frameworkOsPlaygroundDevEnv (repo/lib/js/index.ts) defaults SEMIO_RENDERER to "wgpu" when unset, unlike os/dev/script.ts's own "react" default — hit the wgpu/trunk boot.js build path, which fails trying to bundle Playwright's Node builtins for browser. Fixed by adding explicit "env": {"SEMIO_RENDERER": "react"} to the mit-bestand-aggregator-react-dev entry in .claude/launch.json.
2. node_modules/.vite is Vite's shared default cache dir for the whole workspace — concurrent dev servers for other variants/renderers were clobbering each other's dependency-optimization state. Fixed with an isolated per-variant+renderer cacheDir.
3. Vite's dependency optimizer, when crawling from index.html, genuinely discovers a reachable `playwright` import somewhere in the graph (confirmed via DEBUG=vite:deps trace, not a scan artifact) — playwright-core's own bundling requires chromium-bidi/fsevents native modules that crash esbuild outright, killing the whole dev server. Fixed by excluding playwright/playwright-core/chromium-bidi/fsevents from optimizeDeps.

Final verification: the full 5-step introduction tour completes cleanly end to end with zero console errors, correct German UI/reuse terminology/Abbau Aufbau default/custom branding throughout, ending in a fully functional, unblocked app (Katalog panel open, Move tool active). puzzle-3d-react-dev spot-checked on the same fixed vite.config.ts and confirmed fully unaffected — English UI, semio branding, native terminology, zero errors — proving the brand mechanism is correctly scoped to the aggregator variant only and the shared infrastructure fixes are safe for every other variant.
